name: Product Filter by WuWizards
author: wuwizards

sections.description:
WooCommerce Filter by WuWizards
Product Filter by WuWizards Demo
Plugin FAQ and Documentation
Product Filter by WuWizards plugin enhances your WooCommerce store by empowering customers to refine their searches using filters for price, categories, tags, taxonomies, attributes, and more.

This plugin is fully customizable and seamlessly integrates with Elementor, giving you complete control over the filtering experience.

= Key Features of WooCommerce Product Filter =

Elementor Integration
The Product Filter by WuWizards is fully compatible with Elementor, allowing you to design and manage filters directly from Elementor\’s interface. All features of the plugin are available within the Elementor tab for a smooth and efficient workflow.

AJAX Live Search
Provide a faster shopping experience with AJAX-powered live search. This feature instantly displays filtering results without reloading the page. Customers can select filters and see updated results immediately, ensuring a more intuitive and seamless product search.

Comprehensive Filtering Options
Let customers filter products using various criteria, including:
– Price and price range
– Categories and tags
– Author, featured, on sale, and in-stock items
– Ratings and text search
– Attribute filters (e.g.., size, color, material)

Flexible Display Options
Customize how filters are displayed to match your storefront design. Display formats include:
– Radio button lists (single select)
– Dropdown menus (single select)
– Checkbox lists (multi-select)
– Icon-based attribute filters (e.g., colors, sizes, ratings)

Advanced Statistics
The plugin features a detailed statistics section, enabling you to gather insights about user behavior and filter usage. Use this data to improve your business strategies and support global growth.

Live Preview
With the Live Preview feature, any changes made to the filter settings are instantly reflected in real-time.

Advanced Sorting Options
Allow customers to sort products by various criteria, including:
– Popularity
– Ratings
– Price (low to high or high to low)
– Newest items
– Alphabetical order (ascending or descending)

Quick Filter Creation
Easily create new filters in just a few clicks. Use widgets or shortcodes to add filters to any page effortlessly.

Customizable Price Filter Design
Choose from various skins such as default, flat, big, modern, sharp, round, or square. Customize colors, symbol positions, currency codes, or input fields to suit your branding.

1Automatic Price Range Settings
Define fixed step values for price ranges or adjust them manually to set precise increments.

Product Count Display
Show the exact number of products that match the selected filter criteria, helping users see relevant results instantly.

Fully Responsive Design
The filters are optimized for all devices, ensuring they look and work perfectly on mobile phones, tablets, desktops, and laptops.
sections.installation:
A) VIA FTP

Download the zip archive containing the WooCommerce Product Filter by WuWizards plugin.
Extract the files.
Copy the plugin folder.
Open the /wp-content/plugins/ directory on your server via FTP.
Paste the plugin folder into the directory.
Go to the WordPress admin panel: Plugins => WooCommerce Product Filter by WuWizards.
Click Activate to enable the plugin.
B) DIRECT UPLOAD VIA ADMIN AREA

Download the zip archive containing the plugin.
Navigate to the WordPress admin panel: Plugins => Add New.
Click Upload Plugin and select the zip archive.
Wait for the installation to complete successfully.
Click the Activate button to enable the plugin.
C) VIA WORDPRESS REPOSITORY

Open the WordPress admin panel: Plugins => Add New.
Use the search field to type: \”WooCommerce Filter Plugin by WuPlugins\”.
Find our plugin in the search results and click Install.
Wait for the installation to complete successfully.
Click Activate to start using the plugin.
